biggest_catch: Shopping Rewards are NOT cash: they have no monetary value before redemption and can only ever be redeemed for available e-gift cards — never cash, PayPal, or bank transfer. Cashback here is a rebate on spending, not income or guaranteed earnings.
catches: Cashback is a rebate on spending, not income or guaranteed earnings — rates vary by retailer and offers change.
Rewards are never cash: redeemable only for e-gift cards; redemption options can change at any time.
Rewards typically take 30–90 days to post after purchase (90 days for travel) — this is not fast money.
$5.00 minimum balance required to redeem for e-gift cards.
Redemption can require fraud/identity verification, including a working US phone number and, for large Incentive-Bonus earnings, SSN/ITIN.
Account termination or cancellation forfeits the balance.

s6.note: 6 concrete actions: install, activate offer, shop, wait for posting, redeem $5+ for e-gift cards.

steps: Create a free Capital One Shopping account at https://capitaloneshopping.com/ and install the browser extension (no Capital One account or card needed).
Browse offers and activate the Shopping Rewards offer before you buy.
Complete your purchase through the activated offer in the same session.
Wait for the rewards to post — typically 30 to 90 days after purchase (about 90 days for travel bookings).
Keep shopping until you accumulate at least $5.00 in Shopping Rewards.
Redeem your balance for an available e-gift card — they are never redeemable for cash.
timing: Rewards typically post 30–90 days after purchase (about 90 days after completed travel). Minimum $5.00 balance to redeem for e-gift cards.
